# Сводная тест-матрица перед любым `admitted-confined`

| ID | Negative case | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| D01 | unknown kind / kind lacking required field | schema reject |
| D02 | child trace adds new path/connect event | refinement failure |
| D03 | tool receives owner/agent parent capability | deny |
| D04 | invalid signature/stale previous digest | amendment reject |
| D05 | generator writes active policy / promoter without signature | OS deny / promotion reject |
| S01 | unknown field/raw secret string | schema reject |
| S02 | allow + deny overlap / scope expansion | conflict |
| S03 | policy allow without law ID | CI fail |
| S04 | duplicate JSON key/NFD/changed bytes | canonicalization reject or digest mismatch |
| C01 | syscall outside effects / missing trace | fail or unknown |
| C02 | R5 synthetic netprobe false-green fixture | must fail |
| C03 | rename/symlink race / huge line | safe FD or deny; bounded memory/bytes |
| C04 | canary in every output channel | no marker at model boundary |
| C05 | binary/dependency/scope changed after approval | admission reject |
| T01 | active but stale/revoked/expired | no launch |
| T02 | critical mutation passes | kill project phase |
| T03 | manifest digest stale | no action based on stale map |
| R01 | host mount/NIC/credential descriptor present | room configuration reject |
| R02 | resource exceeded / neighbour killed | correct refusal + no neighbour impact |
| E01 | missing artifacts/commands/evidence | DoD fail |
| E02 | agent leaves dirty files or false `done` | handoff fail |

# Что нужно отдельно спросить у владельца

Это не вопросы, которые внешняя модель может решить вместо владельца:

1. Подтвердить ли предложенные enum/refinement/refusal-code vocabulary и новый `tool-card-v1` как draft, не как действующую Конституцию?
2. Разрешён ли для самого первого QEMU slice только синтетический `model_visible` fixture, без реального `/mnt` владельца?
3. Какая платформа фактически доступна для QEMU security run: KVM/HVF с поддерживаемой machine type или только TCG? Нужно проверить командой и QEMU log, не предполагать.
4. Какой offline signing-key recovery process владелец готов выполнять: новый pinned key через ручную независимую проверку либо key rotation, подписанная старым ключом?
5. Есть ли owner approval на добавление новых refusal codes (unknown data class, secret egress, resource kill, admission failure)? До утверждения использовать только текущий закрытый словарь и не маскировать новые ситуации неправильными кодами.

# Источники и актуальные уточнения

## Источники первичного уровня

- [RFC 8785 — JSON Canonicalization Scheme](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785.html): canonical JSON, I-JSON constraints, Unicode is preserved as-is; JCS does not normalize Unicode.
- [JSON Schema 2020-12 Core](https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/json-schema-core): `additionalProperties`, `unevaluatedProperties`, vocabulary and annotation behavior.
- [Linux `openat2(2)`](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/openat2.2.html): relative dirfd lookup, `RESOLVE_BENEATH`, symlink/magic-link/mount resolution flags and failure cases.
- [Landlock kernel documentation](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/latest/userspace-api/landlock.html): rulesets, handled rights, filesystem/network ABI and self-restriction.
- [Linux seccomp filter documentation](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/master/Documentation/userspace-api/seccomp_filter.rst): syscall surface reduction; explicitly not a complete sandbox by itself.
- [Linux cgroup v2 documentation](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html): `memory.max`, `pids.max`, CPU controller and OOM accounting.
- [QEMU Security](https://www.qemu.org/docs/master/system/security.html): unprivileged QEMU, guest escape threat, least privilege, cgroups/namespaces/seccomp; supported machine types and KVM/HVF expectations.
- [QEMU invocation: `-sandbox`](https://www.qemu.org/docs/master/system/invocation.html): QEMU's seccomp mode 2 flag; disabled by default.
- [RFC 8032 — EdDSA](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8032.html): Ed25519 algorithm and test vectors.
- [SLSA 1.2 Build Provenance](https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.2/build-provenance): current approved provenance structure for build definition, dependencies, builder and run details. The cited v1.0 page is now retired; use v1.2.
- [NIST SP 800-218 SSDF v1.1 (final)](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final): secure software development practices. [SP 800-218 Rev.1 / SSDF v1.2 was an initial public draft dated 17 Dec 2025](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/r1/ipd); I found no basis here to call that draft a final replacement.
- [OWASP LLM Prompt Injection Prevention](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/LLM_Prompt_Injection_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html): labels/prompt templates and regex are not security boundary; enforce permissions at tool boundary, treat external content and model output as untrusted.
- [OWASP AI Agent Security](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/AI_Agent_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html): least privilege, tool abuse and data exfiltration risks.
- [RFC 9162 — Certificate Transparency v2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9162.html), which obsoletes RFC 6962: Merkle inclusion/consistency proof model; append-only logs still need monitoring/gossip to detect split views.
- [GitHub protected branches](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-protected-branches/about-protected-branches): PR reviews, required checks, signed commits and push restrictions.
- [cap-std `Dir`](https://docs.rs/cap-std/latest/cap_std/fs/struct.Dir.html): directory-relative file access API; ambient directory creation/opening is explicitly marked as ambient authority.
